subject: Gradient-based red teaming — kickoff
body:
Hi Ivo,

Kickoff for the gradient-based red teaming workstream, from our EACL 2024 release. Instead of hand-writing adversarial prompts, we optimize them: the EmbedTransformerLm variant accepts embeddings as inputs, simple_decode makes decoding differentiable with Gumbel softmax sampling between steps, and loss_fn scores the safety of the induced response by concatenating the SAFETY tokens and running one more decoding step. Gradients flow end to end, so unsafe-response-inducing prompts are found automatically.

Product goal: automated adversarial prompt discovery as a pre-launch gate for every language model release. Milestones: pipeline on an internal PAX LM by Mar 27, first full sweep Apr 30, gate proposal to LRB May 20.

Chiara, Fumiko and Halima assigned.

Priya
